title.description: The title of the document: on the first page, in the title of the PDF and in the name of its file.

subtitle.description: The subtitle, below the title. Leave it out for no subtitle.

author.description: The name of the author, below the title, in the footer and in the metadata of the PDF.

date.description: The date of the document as it shows below the author, for example 30 October 2026.
